intro: Canopy Ottoman makes every space feel thoughtful. Use it to rest your legs, as extra seating, or as a stylish accent, and enjoy a bold, versatile piece that uplifts your room with ease.

features.title: Multi-functional everyday use
features.text: Transforms into a footrest, seat, or side table, giving you endless flexibility for both casual lounging and hosting.

features.title: Cushioned softness you notice
features.text: Plush padding keeps it supportive yet cozy, so it feels good whether you perch on it or use it for your tired feet.

features.title: Compact, easy to move around
features.text: Lightweight and portable, it shifts easily across rooms, letting you reimagine your layout in seconds.

features.title: Durable fabric built to last
features.text: Upholstery stays soft through frequent use, making it practical for everyday living while retaining elegance.

features.title: Pink that adds bold character
features.text: The vibrant shade brings energy and personality, turning your ottoman into a lively centerpiece in your décor.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
